notes: OTA self-update fix. The update swap batch runs with no console, where 'timeout' fails instantly instead of waiting - which collapsed the 5-minute retry window to milliseconds and rolled back before the exe's brief post-exit lock cleared, so the update 'ran' but nothing changed. Switched the delays to 'ping' (works without a console) so the swap actually completes, and added a result marker so a rolled-back update reports itself instead of failing silently.
